findings: Enrollment needs current-session reauthentication/step-up as policy requires; passkey private key never reaches Tunner.
Primary proof and configured method/context determine session assurance; sensitive-action proof is exact-operation bound and rechecked by its owner.
Persist only credential/public metadata and version; revocation/reset is separately governed; post-commit security activity evidence is required.

figma_refs.purpose: Account security composition, with sample MFA/activity data that cannot be falsely treated as current account facts.
Passkey/method management composition; runtime availability and state require truthful facts.

repository_reuse: Identity store already uses schema3 and migrated AspNetUserPasskeys.

Existing User/Admin separation, restriction/abuse/session service, shared protected operation step-up, versioned policy resolver, strict JSON, outbox and shared UI/form/dialog capabilities must be reused.
ui_boundary: Initial design/flow read only. Review remaining matching feedback/revocation/responsive variants and prepare a concrete scoped approval packet for genuine missing/material adaptations before final production UX. Backend and tests can continue independently.
configuration_boundary: Explicit RP/origin, supported assurance and processing/retention/publication values are trusted approved runtime inputs. No production default invented. P2-019 policy/configuration owner tasks remain applicable.
